target_audience: University students with a basic understanding of calculus and linear algebra

sections.title: Introduction: The Concept of Dimension
lecture_lines: N-dimensional spaces extend our familiar geometry.
2D circles and 3D spheres serve as foundations.
Distances are calculated via the Euclidean norm.
Higher dimensions define points as hyper-bubbles.
Constraint: sum of squares equals radius squared.
animations: Display a point, label as '0D' in #FFFFFF.
Transform point into a line, label '1D' in #00FF00.
Expand line into a square, label '2D' in #0000FF.

sections.title: The Geometry of High-Dimensional Volume
lecture_lines: High-dimensional volume behaves in counter-intuitive ways.
N-ball volumes concentrate near the outer shell.
The hyper-orange's mass exists mostly in the peel.
animations: Create a unit hypercube in high-D space, color #FF00FF.
Show volume calculation formula: V = s^n, color #FFFF00.
Animate hypercube stretching, illustrating volume changes, color #00FFFF.

sections.title: The 'Curse' and 'Blessing' of Dimensionality
lecture_lines: N-balls and hypercubes exhibit different behaviors.
In high dimensions, spheres lose space in corners.
The center becomes a void for high-dimensional objects.
animations: Show data sparsity in high dimensions, color #FFA500.
Highlight distance concentration with a heatmap, color #FF4500.

sections.title: Application: Data Science and Machine Learning
lecture_lines: High-dimensional spheres inform modern machine learning.
They define similarity through cosine metrics.
AI clustering identifies patterns in vast spaces.
animations: Display a scatter plot of high-D data points, color #FFFFFF.
Show classification boundary in 2D projection, color #FFD700.

sections.title: Conclusion: Summary and Visualization
lecture_lines: 3D intuition often fails in high dimensions.
Rely on algebraic constraints, not just visualization.
Higher-dimensional projections continue to spark curiosity.
animations: Quick recap of 0D to nD transitions, color #FFFFFF.
Animate all shapes shrinking into a center, color #FF69B4.
